notes: Real sites are observational normal-case probes; PASS or WARNING is acceptable, not audited security ground truth.
Synthetic ground truth is defined before execution; do not change expectations to fit actual results.
NO_SCT expects WARNING. SCT_TIMESTAMP_OUTSIDE_INTERVAL is a regression case: temporal_interval applies only to NotAfter; overall WARNING remains solely because SCT cryptography is NOT_VERIFIED.
Coverage requires the intended condition to be detected, not merely a matching final status.
